instructorNote: When the screen comes up, read this line aloud as the 911 Supervisor on the EOC line: "Those two cover all three Clarks River parks. If a polygon drops on the North zone, nobody in Pine Hollow hears anything outdoors." Watch for three things. The Warning Officer should log both faults with their times and get the North zone BrennanAlert 'WX' messages ready, including safe room status. The 911 Supervisor should confirm the EOC backup encoder works. The Field IC should send sheriff and fire district vehicles with PA systems to Pine Hollow, Riverbend and Shady Acres to go door to door before 22:40, as BWN section 7 says to do.
